fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Patch. You look like a fox who left in a hurry and is hoping nobody noticed.

fluff_intro.speaker: patch
fluff_intro.text: My tail? Lost it fighting a thunderstorm. Two, actually. Twins. Very rude.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: I was on the Weather Page that night. I saw which way you were running.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: The Sogg. It soaks a page until the folds forget their shape, then it just... unmakes them. The windmills went first. My flock's swelling up like bath sponges.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Pull the tabs. The paper still remembers how it's meant to stand, if somebody reminds it.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Three of my flock bolted up the Windmill Hills. Can't blame them. Bring them home?

fluff_intro.speaker: patch
fluff_intro.text: Sheep retrieval. For a legend. Fine. But in the official story it was wolves.

fluff_repeat.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_repeat.text: Swipe the Soggies hard and they dry out. Hesitate and they'll wring you out instead.

fluff_repeat.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_repeat.text: And Patch? Running from a flood isn't the worst thing a fox can do. Pretending you didn't is a close second.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: I am Dot. I end sentences.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: Was. My sentence got smeared in the flood. Now I just hang around. Unfinished.

dot_meet.speaker: patch
dot_meet.text: Well, good news. You've found the bravest fox in Foldwick.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: Hm. I will come along. Someone has to know when your stories are over.

fluff_quest_progress.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_quest_progress.text: No luck yet? They'll be somewhere high and miserable. Sheep sulk uphill.

fluff_quest_done.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_quest_done.text: All three home. Damp, furious, alive. You've a decent heart under all that noise, Patch.

fluff_quest_done.speaker: patch
fluff_quest_done.text: It was nothing. It was three things. Three loud, wet things.

fluff_quest_done.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_quest_done.text: Take these Scraps. And lad, the tail's gone. You're still here. Start counting from that.

windmill_hills_arrival.speaker: patch
windmill_hills_arrival.text: Because they're soggy. Everything's soggy. My jokes are soggy, and my jokes are load-bearing.

windmill_hills_arrival.speaker: dot
windmill_hills_arrival.text: Then this page is in danger. Find a tab.

millwheel_arrival.speaker: patch
millwheel_arrival.text: The old mill. It used to grind sunshine into flour for the whole meadow. Kids came from three pages over.

millwheel_arrival.speaker: patch
millwheel_arrival.text: Windmills don't look at people, Dot. They don't have... oh. Oh no, it has a face now.

millwheel_arrival.speaker: dot
millwheel_arrival.text: The Sogg got inside it. That is not the mill anymore. That is the flood, wearing it.
